content.heading: frontend - the source of this website
content: **frontend** is the source of this personal website: a landing page and a point-of-interest for those that stumble upon it - personal storytelling through ui, JSON-driven content that is easy to edit, and small interactive features (windows, modals, media embeds).

content.heading: the stack
content: React + TypeScript, Vite for development and builds, xp.css for the nostalgia.
